issue: NAI img2img needs a visible-projection selection source

before.reproduction: Add an NAI img2img control and open its source-layer dropdown while a Krita selection is active.
before.expected: The dropdown includes 选区; choosing it captures the visible-layer projection inside the exact selection bounds, auto-fills the target resolution, runs independent img2img, and returns the result at the selection offset.
before.actual: The dropdown only offered whole canvas and document layers, so a visible composite inside the selection could not be used as the independent img2img source.

adjacent_working_case: Whole-canvas and concrete-layer img2img sources retain their existing source pixels, automatic target sizing, and result placement.
hypothesis: The source selector and ControlLayer only represent a null whole-canvas ID or a real layer ID, so no stable value can route selection bounds to the visible document projection.
disproof: The hypothesis would be false if a persisted selection source ID already reached ControlLayer.to_api as a visible projection crop and DocumentModel already used its selection bounds for job placement.
